mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.color_name, c.status as color_status, c.remarks as color_remarks, b.brand_name, b.status as brand_status, b.remarks as brand_remarks, t.type_name, t.status as type_status FROM shoes s LEFT JOIN colors c ON s.color_id = c.color_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON s.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN types t ON s.type_id = t.type_id ORDER BY s.shoe_id DESC

SELECT s.*, c.color_name, c.status as color_status, c.remarks as color_remarks, b.brand_name, b.status as brand_status, b.remarks as brand_remarks, t.type_name, t.status as type_status, pi.image_id, pi.image_url, pi.image_name, pi.image_type, pi.sort_order, pi.is_main, pi.status as image_status, pi.created_at as image_created_at, pi.updated_at as image_updated_at FROM shoes s LEFT JOIN colors c ON s.color_id = c.color_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON s.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN types t ON s.type_id = t.type_id LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON s.shoe_id = pi.shoe_id AND pi.status = 1 WHERE s.shoe_id = #{shoeId} ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.sort_order ASC

SELECT s.*, c.color_name, c.status as color_status, c.remarks as color_remarks, b.brand_name, b.status as brand_status, b.remarks as brand_remarks, t.type_name, t.status as type_status FROM shoes s LEFT JOIN colors c ON s.color_id = c.color_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON s.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN types t ON s.type_id = t.type_id WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.color_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY s.shoe_id DESC
